name: Non-alcoholic highball or spritz

slots.note: tea, tisane or a non-alcoholic distillate
non-alcoholic aperitif: the spritz; the band is chosen, not sourced
soda, tonic, ginger beer; a ferment adds ethanol

source.name: docs/non-alcoholic.md, Proposed templates and variants; slots and ratios are those of the parent template, ranges are computed from its nominal spec with the base replaced volume for volume by a drink without ethanol
source.note: Assumption, unverified: no source says that these ratios or ranges fit a drink without ethanol; see docs/templates.md#variants-by-alcohol-class.

notes: Highball with an optional bitter slot, so that a spritz (aperitif plus lengthener) and a shrub drink (the shrub as base) match without a template of their own. No ABV range. A ferment as lengthener raises the ABV (kombucha 0 to 3.62 % observed, docs/non-alcoholic.md), so such a drink is classified by its computed ABV.
